title: Vegan Perilla Confit
description: A flavorful, plant-based take on traditional confit using perilla seeds and a mix of spices.

ingredients.name: Nourishing oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or avocado oil

instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together perilla seeds, nourishing oil, chewy dates, French onion powder, and minced garlic.
3. Spread the mixture evenly onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
4. Bake for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the seeds are fragrant and lightly toasted.
5. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
6. Stir in salt, parsley, and vegan bouillon powder.
7. Serve warm or at room temperature.
